{() =>
                p.carry(
                  p.tool === "Makeup Match"
                    ? `${p.style} · ${family} color mood ${String(shade + 1).padStart(2, "0")} (illustrative)`
                    : p.style,

              }

handler_source.onSubmit: {async e => { e.preventDefault(); const values = new FormData(e.currentTarget); await act(data.profile ? "PATCH" : "POST", "/profile", { handle: values.get("creator-handle"), display_name: values.get("creator-name"), bio: values.get("creator-bio"), ...(data.profile ? { expected_revision: data.profile.revision } : {}) }); }}
{async e => { e.preventDefault(); if (await act("POST", "/connections", { provider, profile_url: url })) setUrl(""); }}
{async e => { e.preventDefault(); if (await act("POST", "/media", { provider, source_url: mediaUrl, title, rights_confirmed: rights })) { setTitle(""); setMediaUrl(""); setRights(false); } }}
{async e => { e.preventDefault(); if (await act("POST", "/collections", { title: collection, sponsored, disclosure, rights_confirmed: true, product_ids: [] })) setCollection(""); }}
